  Tuesday, September 26, 2023
  6:30 P.M.

minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  September 26, 2023

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Crosby at 6:30 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, YFAC Chair, Council Member
  Greg Palatto, BUSD Board Member
  Don Kendrick, Resident
  Denise Fisher, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the August 22, 2023, meeting were
  reviewed and approved.

3. SRO Report  School Resource Officer (SRO) Eddie Burgos
  reported that the school year is going well so far. He
  has been visiting La Verne schools and noted that he
  is beginning to get familiar with his role as the SRO.

4. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers shared the school year was off to a
  smooth start and that there has been an added focus
  on student attendance, academic performance, and
  social/emotional wellness. The group celebrated the
  announcement of Grace Miller Elementary being
  named a Blue Ribbon School, the upcoming Bonita
  High School Trade Fair, and the recent spotlight of
  Bonita High School on local television news.

5. Program Review  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells shared that YFAC
  is funded completely through donations. The last
  fundraiser was approximately 5 years ago and the
  committee has continued to do programs, but has not
  increased funds or donations. JR reported that as a
  result of the opportunity presented through the Ruth &
  Joseph Reed foundation, staff had submitted
  information to the IRS in hopes of being able to accept
  funds. Executive Board Member Don Kendrick shared
  information about the foundation and how YFAC’s
  programs were in line with their goals. The group
  discussed several different program ideas that might
  benefit today’s youth. Direction was given for staff to
  work with BUSD and Chair Crosby to develop a
  program that reaches out directly to BUSD teachers
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes September 26, 2023, page 2

  and staff for ideas that they think would help
  community youth.

6. Public Comment  Executive Board Member Denise Fisher shared
  information regarding an upcoming K-9 Foundation
  Fundraiser on December 2nd. Carolyn (didn’t record
  last name) suggested resources for parents such as
  workshops and information that would be helpful in
  protecting kids.

7. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for October
  24, 2023.

8. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:37 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
YFAC Staff Liaison
